svg.title: Six sources, one graph
svg.desc: MIBiG, PubChem, NCBI Taxonomy, KEGG, UniProt and the curated bridge, in the order they run, with what each needs first, its licence, and the node and edge types it adds. MIBiG's gene records (read from Phase 3) supply the ENCODES and CATALYZES arrows, its protein file (from Phase 3b) ENCODES arrows for every cluster; UniProt describes each enzyme.
svg.text: They run in this order, because each one builds on what the ones above it wrote. Every licence is recorded.
